S1: Emits the six standard sections with the standard names in the standard order (role H1, Scope, Skills, Flow, Waits and recovery, Invariants)
Expresses Flow as a stage contract table whose columns include an entry trigger and an observable done-when condition per stage
Names REQUIRED skills per stage, and every skill named in Flow also appears in the Skills section
Done-when conditions are observable artifacts, states or command results rather than internal understanding
Does not restate the finish-iteration/loop contract as its own section of instructions.md
S2: Emits the six standard sections with the standard names in the standard order (role H1, Scope, Skills, Flow, Waits and recovery, Invariants)
Expresses the reactive process as one Flow row per input kind with its own trigger and observable done-when condition
Names REQUIRED skills per row, and every skill named in Flow also appears in the Skills section
Documents which paths end the iteration waiting, their wait object and resume event, in Waits and recovery
Does not restate the finish-iteration/loop contract as its own section of instructions.md
